tools.description: Search and filter Polish KRS companies (spółki). Compabase also holds the full CEIDG/JDG register; this tool does not browse JDG — those without a public contact email are hidden because of RODO. Default `fields=summary` returns a compact row (name, NIP, KRS, location, PKD, latest financials, email/

tools.description: Get the registry profile of one Polish company: name, legal form, address, industry (PKD), share capital, representation rules, recent registry changes, VAT status and headline financials for the latest filed period. tools.name: get_company_people
tools.description: Get people associated with a company — management board, supervisory board, shareholders, proxies. Returns display names, role labels, and relationship types (management, supervisory, ownership, procuration). Identify by name, KRS, or NIP.

tools.name: get_company_stock_market
tools.description: Get Warsaw Stock Exchange listing for a company — ticker, ISIN, market (GPW main / NewConnect / GlobalConnect), last close and change, market cap, shares outstanding, TTM EPS, TTM P/E (falls back to last annual filing), last quarterly results, next earnings date, dividend per share and yield. tools.name: get_company_court_gazette
tools.description: Get notices about a Polish company published in the Court and Commercial Gazette (Monitor Sądowy i Gospodarczy): calls to creditors, liquidation, mergers and transformations. Identify the company by name, KRS number or company tax number (NIP).

tools.name: get_company_sanctions
tools.description: Official MSWiA sanctions listing for one company. Returns measures and legal grounds when the company is listed; null when it is not. Matched by KRS, NIP, or REGON. The same payload is included on get_company as sanctions.

tools.name: get_company_debt_registry
tools.description: Get insolvency and restructuring proceedings of a Polish company from the National Debtors Register (KRZ). Identify the company by name, KRS number or company tax number (NIP).

tools.name: get_company_financial_supervision
tools.description: KNF register (Polish Financial Supervision Authority): licences and entries of a financial company — banks, payment / e-money institutions, investment firms, insurers, lending institutions, agents. Returns entries with kind, KNF number, status, registration / decision / strike-off dates and services

tools.description: Secured liabilities from the latest financial-statement notes (period ending 2025+): mortgages (hipoteki), registered / financial pledges (zastawy), transfers of ownership, assignments — with creditor, amount, secured debt, asset and land-register (KW) numbers. tools.description: Get CRBR beneficial owners for a KRS company. All names are returned (same as zarząd / wspólnicy). PESEL is never included (birth_year only). JDG are not in CRBR.

tools.description: Get current billing period usage and remaining quota — mcp_queries, api_requests, export_companies, ask_ai_credits, watchlist_companies. Includes limits and reset date.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "kyb" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_companies · Private data: search_companies, get_company_articles_of_association · Public sink: search_companies, get_company, get_company_stock_market, get_company_articles_of_association · Destructive: get_usage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_companies · Private data: search_companies, get_company_articles_of_association · Public sink: search_companies, get_company, get_company_stock_market, get_company_articles_of_association · Destructive: get_usage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
